title: Past Tense Grammar Fix
sentences: Yesterday, we went to the science museum. | Yesterday, we go to the science museum.
She bought a new blue backpack on Saturday. | She buyed a new blue backpack on Saturday.
They didn't watch the movie last night. | They didn't watched the movie last night.
Did you see the fireworks at the park? | Did you saw the fireworks at the park?
My brother ate three slices of pizza. | My brother eated three slices of pizza.
We were very tired after the long hike. | We was very tired after the long hike.
He forgot his umbrella on the train. | He forget his umbrella on the train.
I wrote a postcard to my grandmother. | I writed a postcard to my grandmother.
